sections.content: Use decir que, contar que, explicar que and similar reporting verbs to introduce reported statements.

items.spanish: Él me dijo que no tenía tiempo.
items.english: He told me that he did not have time.
She explained that she lived there.

items.spanish: La mujer afirmó que había oído un ruido extraño.
items.english: The woman stated that she had heard a strange noise.
